servicesHead: Cleaning that fits around your life
servicesSub: Weekly, fortnightly or just when you need a hand. Petrina matches you with a cleaner and keeps in touch.

services.title: Regular home cleans
services.short: Weekly or fortnightly cleans by the same trusted cleaner.
services.long: Book a regular weekly or fortnightly clean and get the same friendly cleaner each time, someone who knows your home and how you like it done.

services.title: Unit & apartment cleans
services.short: Kitchens, bathrooms, floors and dusting, finished with real attention to detail.
services.long: Units and apartments cleaned top to bottom: kitchen, bathroom, floors, dusting and the small details that make a place feel fresh.

services.title: Short-term help
services.short: Extra support when cleaning has become too much for a while.
services.long: Going through illness, recovery or a busy patch? Petrina can organise a cleaner to come weekly for a short period and help you get back on your feet.
points: Weekly visits for as long as you need

services.title: Big one-off cleans
services.short: For the jobs that need extra time and elbow grease.
services.long: For homes that need a bigger effort, the team takes on the hard jobs and leaves everything sparkling at a fair price.

whyHead: Why Redcliffe locals stick with Petrina
whyText: Clients mention their cleaners by name in reviews: Kim, Kristy and Dot. Petrina keeps in contact, sends reminders and checks you're happy after every clean.

galleryHead: Fresh, clean and ready to enjoy

reviews.text: Kim my cleaner is reliable, friendly and gives a totally professional clean every time. She makes my unit shine and smell so fresh!
Their communication has been excellent from the start, and they've been so helpful and accommodating when I needed.
She quickly organised a cleaner to come weekly for a short period and get me back on my feet again.
By the time she'd finished, everything was sparkling and lemon fresh. The price was more than reasonable.
Dot is the most incredible cleaner! Her attention to detail is fantastic. She goes above and beyond.
Petrina is so reliable, keeping in contact, reminding us of cleaning and seeking feedback.

faq: Call or text Petrina on 0433 154 325, or send the booking form and she'll get back to you.
Will I get the same cleaner each time?
For regular cleans, Petrina matches you with a cleaner who comes back each visit.
Can I book a one-off clean?
Yes. One-off and short-term cleans are welcome as well as regular bookings.
Scarborough and the Redcliffe Peninsula. Ask if you're nearby and not sure.
aboutSub: A local cleaning business built on reliability and kindness.
aboutParas: Petrina's Cleaning Services is a small local team based in Scarborough, looking after homes and units across the Redcliffe Peninsula.
Petrina handles the bookings and keeps in touch with every client, while her cleaners, including Kim, Kristy and Dot, take care of the cleaning.
Clients say it's the communication that sets the business apart: reminders before each clean, quick replies and a genuine check that you're happy.
values: Your cleaner turns up when booked, every time.
Reminders, quick replies and feedback after cleans.
The small things done properly, not rushed.
